sentences.translation: A couple lived in Naniwa, Settsu Province.
Since there is no child, I asked the god of Sumiyoshi to do his best to make a prayer and ask him, "Please don't leave the child alone. Even a little child like a finger will do it."
Soon after, Okami became a mate.
Before long, Okami gave birth to a little man's baby.
But it was so small that it was really only as big as a finger.
When I said that even a child of the size of a finger, I was given a child of only a finger by the god.'
The couple laughed and raised the child.
But she was not always bigger than her fingers.
The couple gave up and named the child Issunboshi.
One day, the Digitist went out to her father and mother and said, "Please give me some time."
I think I'll go to Kyoto from now on.'
The ichiman-shi immediately took the preparation for the journey.
First, I gave her a wet needle, and with straw, she made a handle and a saw, and put it on her waist.
Then, with the new Ohan boat, I sailed from Sumiyoshi Beach with the new Ohashi no Kashi.
